content: Exception receipt reconciliation only marks issued then raises. The owning failed leg loses rerank_issuance, including unknown when no readable receipt exists. Publish the current question tri-state into its terminal while preserving the original error.

failure_service_records.query_id is not compared with qid before accepting its rerank call. A foreign question receipt credits this question with one issued HTTP. Verify attribution and leave unknown when only foreign evidence exists.

answer_temperature is required and type-checked but never compared with the actual fixed zero. A complete anchor declaring temperature=1 passes. Compare the declared temperature with actual generation temperature; keep zero positive.
